pairs: and only the grave will be left for me.
et in amaritudinibus moratur oculus meus.
yet my eye remains in bitterness.
et cujusvis manus pugnet contra me.
and let the hand of anyone you wish fight against me.
Cor eorum longe fecisti a disciplina:
You have set their heart far from discipline;
therefore, they will not be praised.
He promises prey to his companions,
but the eyes of his sons will grow faint.
Posuit me quasi in proverbium vulgi,
He has posted me like a proverb to the people,
and I am an example in their presence.
My eyesight has been clouded by indignation,
et membra mea quasi in nihilum redacta sunt.
and my limbs have been reduced, as if to nothing.
The just will be astounded over this,
and the innocent will be stirred up against the hypocrite.
And the just will cling to his way,
and clean hands will increase strength.
et non inveniam in vobis ullum sapientem.
and approach, for I do not find in you any wisdom.
They have turned night into day,
et rursum post tenebras spero lucem.
and I hope for light again after the darkness.
et in tenebris stravi lectulum meum.
and in darkness I have spread out my bed.
Ubi est ergo nunc præstolatio mea?
Therefore, where is my expectation now,
and who is it that considers my patience?
In profundissimum infernum descendent omnia mea:
Everything of mine will descend into the deepest underworld; do you think that,
putasne saltem ibi erit requies mihi?
in that place at least, there will be rest for me?
